citation.title: Nagasaki University Analysis: A Complete Cephalometric Guide

curation.notes: accessed 2026-10-07 (both extractors read the live page that day). Page dated June 12, 2026. The page names no source paper for the norms and describes no sample. Merge 2026-10-08: a and b agree on every value, unit and definitionMatch; only the source wording differed (b's row-specific wording kept). Re-read with WebFetch on 2026-10-08 (15:21): every value matched.

caveats: Website values, not from a paper (status website; never coloured).
The page itself says its norms are still being checked against the original papers (re-read 8 Oct).
No source paper, sample, population, sex or age stated on the page.
The page prints every norm as 'x ± y' without saying whether y is an SD or a range; stored as sd with a note.
SNA, SNB, ANB and SN–MP are identical to the onfile ABO page (82 ± 2, 80 ± 2, 2 ± 2, 32 ± 5), possibly a copied template; kept as printed.

SN–MP and IMPA are written 'Go–Me' without saying which gonion; entered as the catalogue's #21 and #57 (Go–Me), 'same'. onfile's Björk–Jarabak page constructs gonion; if this page does too, these would be 'close'.
